title: A login vendor's renewal notice at a 32% higher price

objects.subject: Your Authwise Pro plan renews on 15 Oct
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Your Authwise Pro plan renews on 15 October 2026 at $1,320 per year (currently $1,000) - a 32% increase under our new pricing. To change or cancel, manage your plan before the renewal date.

Authwise Billing
